title: Penstock DMN test cases
description: Saved test cases for the decision tables of a DMN file, kept next to it as <name>.dmn.tests.json. Penstock runs them on the decision table and shows which rules each case matched.

$schema.description: The address of this schema, for editors.

cases.description: One entry per test case, run in this order.

decision.description: The id of the decision, which can be a decision table or a decision that requires others.

inputs.description: The values the decision starts with, by the input expression of each decision table; a name with a dot reaches into an object.

expected.description: The outputs the decision must give, by output name. Only the outputs listed are compared; none listed means no rule may match.

rules.description: Optional: the numbers of the rules that must be the ones applied, counted from 1.
